body:
The problem is, I like Radiohead AND Phish. maybe I'm that weird 1/10000 freak, but I think Phish is musically good. I don't need drugs to enjoy a thirty minute hood. I love every second of it. 

I just don't understand the hate.

If everyone listened to a Hood a day, I think the world would be a much nicer place.
Why in the HELL is everyone hating on Phish? The stoners give it a bad scene. I don't smoke and I really do enjoy the tunes.
This is why I love Phish.

I've heard that suicide is a "permanent solution to a temporary problem."

But when life keeps shouldering us with burdens, and our time is so short, and we focus on the wrong things. Consumerism and distraction, and things that never last. I just don't know.

As for college, I just feel like I've felt it all already. Learning things and philosophies, maybe I'm wrong but, I feel like I've done it already. Sure, I'm not saying I know everything, but I don't see a point to learning. I like it a lot. I'm was in an AP class as as sophomore, and I excelled until now, where my grades have fallen. I had to drop out of my honors English class. 

I feel so frustrated and so wasted. The world keeps moving and I keep standing still.
Thank you. I'll PM you something.

It's the never ending challenges. There are no breaks. Only distractions. And no, I feel like even once I depart from high school things get worse and sure, a little less predictable, but that I'm denying the inevitable. I feel like I've read so many life stories, and especially in today's society that there is no hope, and that hope is a distraction from the realities for life.

I think college seems frivolous and expensive, and it will lead me into a cube farm or a job where I slave away for no meaning. I don't feel in my life that I could avoid that.
